glosses: An improved component or replacement item, usually applied to technology.

examples.text: Near-synonym: option

glosses: To improve, usually applied to technology, generally by complete replacement of one or more components.

examples.text: When you upgrade your standard of living, you become addicted to that standard of living.

glosses: To improve the equipment or furnishings of or services rendered to.

examples.text: They upgraded him to the latest model.

glosses: To improve in condition or status.

examples.text: She upgraded to a more successful husband.

glosses: To replace a program with a later version of itself, a version having a higher version number or marketed under a more recent product name.
